page.content:
Commissioner who globalized the league in the Jordan years.

How David Stern connects

  • Topic: NBA — David Stern was the commissioner who globalized the NBA.
  • Character: Adam Silver — Adam Silver followed David Stern as commissioner in 2014.
  • Faction: Dream Team — Stern's office helped turn NBA stars loose on the 1992 Olympics.

What is David Stern?

David Stern was NBA commissioner from 1984 to 2014, the executive who marketed Magic, Bird, and Jordan, weathered the 1998–99 lockout, and turned the Finals into a worldwide product.

Key threads lead to NBA, Adam Silver and Dream Team.
